rule_text: In each complete 10-minute window of the split: (a) a normalised link posted by >= 5 distinct accounts, or (b) a hashtag used by >= 8 distinct accounts, where no account posts it more than 3 times, at least that many accounts wrote some text, and <= 20% of the posts with text reuse another account's normalised text; or (c) one of the 10 posts liked/reposted by the most (>= 50) distinct accounts. Then a deterministic sample of up to 40 of its accounts is looked up (public AppView profile, PLC log when the profile has no createdAt): >= 80% must resolve and >= 80% of those must be >= 365 days old with >= 30 followers and >= 30 posts. Detector output is never used.
labels: HEURISTIC organic labels, not ground truth, until a human checks a sample
